card.name: Punctuation and digits in textbook citations
card.fires_on: Publisher and year parts of reference citations for medical textbooks and journals, such as the year, semicolon or chapter number after 'Saunders Elsevier'. Also the final letter of 'PRECAUTIONS' in a cross-reference.

modes.label: Citation details
modes.description: Year digits, semicolons, colons and page or chapter numbers in a book or journal reference at the end of a patient-information page.
modes.example: Goldman L, Schafer AI, eds. Cecil Medicine. 24th ed. Philadelphia, PA: Saunders Elsevier<<;>> 2011:chap

modes.label: PRECAUTIONS cross-reference
modes.description: The ending of the word PRECAUTIONS inside a parenthetical 'See PRECAUTIONS' pointer in a drug label.
modes.example: beginning, periodically during, and before reinstituting methotrexate therapy (See PRECAUTION<<S>> ) . Appropriate steps should be taken

card.writes: It suppresses 'details' and 'detail' and promotes unrelated staff-like words, so it has no clear output effect on the text.
card.plain: It marks the small bits of a reference citation, such as the year and chapter number, or the end of a 'See PRECAUTIONS' pointer.
